import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 2

def design(feats):
    # Filter out correlated features (keep only one from each pair)
    correlated_pairs = {
        ('YRLC18', 'AJBV4'), ('YRLC18', 'KAN11'), ('VEI12', 'YRLC18'),
        ('XPII7', 'YRLC18'), ('YRLC18', 'JYY12'), ('XPII7', 'VEI12'),
        ('BII15', 'AJBV4'), ('XPII7', 'FCY5'), ('VEI12', 'GNA18L'),
        ('KAN11', 'AJBV4'), ('JYY12', 'AJBV4'), ('JWZ8', 'AJBV4'),
        ('GNA18L', 'YRLC18'), ('KAT15A', 'XPII7'), ('GNA18L', 'KAN11'),
        ('VEI12', 'KAN11'), ('KAT15A', 'FCY5'), ('YRLC18', 'BII15'),
        ('JWZ8', 'YRLC18'), ('VEI12', 'AJBV4')
    }
    
    # Build set of features to exclude due to correlation
    exclude = set()
    for a, b in correlated_pairs:
        if a in feats.ids and b in feats.ids:
            # Keep the one with higher t-statistic
            ia, ib = feats.column(a), feats.column(b)
            ta, tb = abs(stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[:,ia][feats.y==1], feats.x[:,ia][feats.y==0]).statistic), \
                     abs(stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[:,ib][feats.y==1], feats.x[:,ib][feats.y==0]).statistic)
            exclude.add(b if ta > tb else a)
    
    # Select features for analysis
    keep = [fid for fid in feats.ids if fid not in exclude]
    
    # Calculate effect sizes (t-stats) for selected features
    effects = []
    for fid in keep:
        col = feats.column(fid)
        tstat = stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[:,col][feats.y==1], feats.x[:,col][feats.y==0]).statistic
        effects.append((abs(tstat), fid))
    
    # Sort by effect size and select top features
    effects.sort(reverse=True)
    drivers = [fid for _, fid in effects[:MAX_DRIVERS]]
    
    # For logistic regression, include only top 3 features
    columns = [fid for _, fid in effects[:3]]
    
    # No interaction terms for simplicity
    products = ()
    
    # Simple weighted score using top features
    loadings = {fid: 1.0 for fid in columns}
    
    return Design(
        drivers=tuple(drivers),
        columns=tuple(columns),
        products=products,
        loadings=loadings
    )
